reference: Four photos: front, left side, right side, back of a single-storey tiled house in a garden
Hipped Mangalore-tile roof (~28 deg), wide eaves (~1.3 m) with exposed dark rafter ends
Off-white lime walls, red-oxide band ~0.65 m on the front, mud-brown back wall
Raised laterite plinth with red-oxide ledge, two concrete steps at the centre door
Left window with iron grill, right two-pane casement, blue frames; satellite dish on the right slope
Kitchen annex with lean-to tiled roof behind on the left; wooden post and blue drums at the back
Banana plants and a coconut palm around
steps: plinth walls into the ground, floor on top
walls, red band and frame lining into the floor
ceiling on the walls, rafters under it, trusses on it
roof panels on the trusses, tiles into the panels
annex walls into the ground, lean-to roof on its side walls
post, drums and plants into the ground
checks: every part tabs into the part it stands on
tile pieces split clear of truss and hip slots

product.name: My home
product.description: Glue-free 3 mm plywood model of the house in the photos, about 1:40. Assumptions: front 9.4 m, depth 4.6 m, walls 2.2 m, roof pitch 28 deg with 1.3 m eaves; sizes estimated from the photos. The red band and the blue frames are separate boards in front of / behind the front wall; the roof tiles are courses of small pieces standing on the roof panels.
